bandReport.notes: Band covers Q1-Q22 across p00 (Q1-7), p01 (Q8-14), p02 (Q15-22). Q1 is the first question of the paper, so nothing precedes it. Q22 is complete on p02: its stem and all four options print on p02, and p03 opens cleanly at Q23 (left column) and Q26 (right column), so there is no straddle at the seam. There is NO Directions block anywhere in p00-p02: every question here is a standalone MCQ with no shared stimulus, so no set is opened by this band and none is inherited from an earlier one. No figures in this band. Layout is two-column, read left column top-to-bottom then right column; numbering runs down the left column (1-3 on p00) then continues down the right column (4-7).

questions.stem:
Two unequal pairs of numbers satisfy the following conditions :

(i) The product of the two numbers in each pair is 2160

(ii) The HCF of the two numbers in each pair is 12.

If \(x\) is the mean of the numbers in the first pair and \(y\) is the mean of the numbers in the second pair, then what is the mean of \(x\) and \(y\) ?
How many digits are there in \((54)^{10}\) ? (Given that \(\log_{10} 2 = 0.301\) and \(\log_{10} 3 = 0.477\))
Which one of the following is a set of solutions of the equation \(x^{\sqrt{x}} = \sqrt[n]{x^{x}}\), if \(n\) is a positive integer ?

In a competitive examination, 250 students have registered. Out of these, 50 students have registered for Physics, 75 students for Mathematics and 35 students for both Mathematics and Physics. What is the number of students who have registered neither for Physics nor for Mathematics ?
questions.subtopic: Counting Sets, Subsets and Inclusion Exclusion

questions.stem: If the sum of the digits of a number \(10^{n} - 1\), where \(n\) is a natural number, is equal to 3798, then what is the value of \(n\) ?
Which one of the following is the largest number among \(2222^{2}\), \(222^{22}\), \(22^{222}\), \(2^{2222}\) ?
If \(m\) is the number of prime numbers between 0 and 50; and \(n\) is the number of prime numbers between 50 and 100, then what is \((m - n)\) equal to ?
If \(\frac{a}{b} = \frac{1}{3}\), \(\frac{b}{c} = 2\), \(\frac{c}{d} = \frac{1}{2}\), \(\frac{d}{e} = 3\) and \(\frac{e}{f} = \frac{1}{4}\), then what is the value of \(\frac{abc}{def}\) ?
Which one of the following is the largest divisor of \(3^{x} + 3^{x+1} + 3^{x+2}\), if \(x\) is any natural number ?
A two-digit number is 9 more than four times of the number obtained by interchanging its digits. If the product of digits in the two-digit number is 8, then what is the number ?
If \(\alpha\) and \(\beta\) are the roots of the quadratic equation \(x^{2} + kx - 15 = 0\) such that \(\alpha - \beta = 8\), then what is the positive value of \(k\) ?
questions.subtopic: Vieta's Relations and Root Coefficient Identities

questions.stem: What are the values of \(p\) and \(q\) respectively, if \((x - 1)\) and \((x + 2)\) divide the polynomial \(x^{3} + 4x^{2} + px + q\) ?
If \((x + k)\) is the HCF of \(x^{2} + 5x + 6\) and \(x^{2} + 8x + 15\), then what is the value of \(k\) ?
If \(5^{x+1} - 5^{x-1} = 600\), then what is the value of \(10^{2x}\) ?
A number divides 12288, 28200 and 44333 so as to leave the same remainder in each case. What is that number ?
If \(x^{2} + 9y^{2} = 6xy\), then what is \(y : x\) equal to ?
If \(m\) and \(n\) are positive integers such that \(m^{n} = 1331\), then what is the value of \((m - 1)^{n-1}\) ?
What is \(\frac{1}{a^{m-n} - 1} + \frac{1}{a^{n-m} - 1}\) equal to ?
If \(x = \sqrt{2}\), \(y = \sqrt[3]{3}\) and \(z = \sqrt[6]{6}\), then which one of the following is correct ?
If \(\log x = 1.2500\) and \(y = x^{\log x}\), then what is \(\log y\) equal to ?
